_comment: Per-country transmission voltage floor (kV) for metric I4, pinned 30 August 2026 per AMENDMENT_DRAFT_I4_transmission_thresholds.md. A line counts toward I4 when kv >= floor. Entries marked needs_pin are held out until a flag-officer decision; the derivation refuses to run for them.
_basis: measured line-km by voltage from each country's grid-geo.json; floor is the TSO transmission tier

uk._basis: The UK holds three transmission definitions. A single national floor is wrong in both directions: 132 counts 17,783 km of English and Welsh DISTRIBUTION as transmission, 275 drops 4,880 km of genuine Scottish and Northern Irish TRANSMISSION.

_us_basis: NERC Bulk Electric System: Transmission Elements operated at 100 kV or higher. A cited standard, not our choice; and 100 vs 115 moves only 9,842 km (1%), so the pin is insensitive to it. Excludes 69 kV (360,666 km), which NERC excludes.
_greenland_basis: Held on the reasoning that 132 kV is implausible for the system. The data disagrees: 132 kV is 80.2 km, 30.3% of greenland's line-km — the Buksefjord-Nuuk hydro link — above a 60/63/66/70 kV tier of 148.1 km, with 10.5 kV town distribution below. Nukissiorfiit runs isolated town grids linked to hydro plants; the 60 kV floor captures every hydro-to-town transmission link (228.3 km, 28 records) and excludes town distribution. A 132 kV floor would leave 80 km on 12 records. Substation voltages corroborate: 3 at 63 kV, 17 at 10.5 kV.

_needs_pin.luxembourg: 57.5% of line-km carries no voltage. TESTED against OSM 31 Aug 2026: only 116 of 797 untagged lines exist in OSM even including minor_line and cable, and NONE carries a voltage tag. Not recoverable from OSM.
_needs_pin.iceland: 50.2% of line-km carries no voltage. TESTED against OSM 31 Aug 2026: grid-geo line ids are 1..1,427, sequential synthetic integers rather than OSM way ids, so no id join exists; OSM holds only 153 voltage-bearing lines for the whole country against 1,230 untagged register lines. Not recoverable from OSM.

_mexico_basis: Held at 50.6% of line-km with no voltage. Recovered 8,426 line voltages from OSM by way-id join gated on geometry (both endpoints within 50 m; median agreement 0.4 m), taking the untagged share to 1.5%. The ladder is then CFE's grid — 115 kV 72,852 km, 230 kV 45,063 km, 400 kV 40,327 km, 138/161 kV below, 34.5/13.8 kV distribution. CFE's Red Nacional de Transmision is 400/230/161/138/115 kV, so 115 kV is the floor.
